title: AI Image-Based Price Search Platform Pricescan Launches to Help Users Find New and Used Item Prices Online
text:
AI Image-Based Price Search Platform Pricescan Launches to Help Users Find New and Used Item Prices Online
LONDON, UK – Pricescan today announced the launch of its innovative AI-powered image-based price search platform, designed to help consumers find new and used prices for items simply by uploading a photo. The platform leverages advanced computer vision technology and intelligent automation to search the web for relevant product listings from multiple sources based on the user's geographic location.
Pricescan enables users to take or upload a photograph of any item and quickly discover pricing information without needing to know the exact product name or manually search across multiple websites. By analyzing the uploaded image, the platform identifies similar items and retrieves available pricing results from online marketplaces, retailers, and resale platforms worldwide.
The platform is purpose-built for everyday consumers who want a faster and more intuitive way to research prices, particularly for secondhand goods, resale items, vintage products, or hard-to-identify objects. Pricescan operates directly in the web browser and does not require users to download or install any additional software or mobile applications.
"Our goal with Pricescan is to make price research simpler and more accessible when traditional text-based searches fall short," said a spokesperson for Pricescan. "By allowing users to start their search with an image, we help them find relevant pricing information even when they don't know exactly what an item is called or how to describe it accurately."
Key features of the Pricescan platform include:
- AI-powered image recognition that identifies products from user-uploaded photos
- Location-based search results showing prices from local and international sellers
- Comprehensive price comparison across new and used marketplaces
- Browser-based access with no app installation required
- Support for a wide range of product categories including electronics, fashion, collectibles, and household items
Pricescan is now available online and can be accessed through its official website at pricescan.ai. The platform is free to use and supports users worldwide.
About Pricescan
Pricescan is a web-based AI platform that uses advanced image recognition technology to help users find new and used prices for items across the internet. By enabling users to search with an image instead of keywords, the platform simplifies the price discovery process and helps consumers make more informed purchasing decisions. For more information, visit pricescan.ai.
